plan: Queue jungle as primary. It is Xeebs's best role at 52.8% over 311 games (overall is 50.2%). Set midlane as secondary, not the other way around.
Stop queueing carry: 42.6% over 190 games is costing real VP. When auto-filled there, play the safest comfort pick, not a learning pick.
Xeebs's champion pool is 10+ heroes wide and the top three are only 40% of the games. Gold-to-Platinum climbs are almost always pool-narrowing stories: aim for 70%+ of games on the top three.
The math: Xeebs is at 323 VP; Platinum III starts at 900. The all-time peak is 692.
honesty: personal winrates are shrunk toward the player's own average (small heater samples do not count as mains)
field baselines are all-ranks aggregates from our current-patch match sample, not Gold-bracket-specific yet
winrate edges are observational; they say where the player wins, not why

insights.title: Vision is Xeebs's cheapest upgrade
insights.finding: 4.7 wards per game, 56% of the squad average. Wards cost nothing and they are being left in the shop.
insights.receipt: 4,208 placed + 265 cleared over 947 games; squad average 8.5/game

insights.title: Mr_Meat31 brings out Xeebs's best
insights.finding: Xeebs's record alongside Mr_Meat31 is 54% over 268 ranked games — the strongest pairing in the stack. When only two of the squad queue, make it this pair.

insights.title: Khaimera is the long-term relationship
insights.finding: 168 games on Khaimera at 54.0% — the field averages 52.9%. The comfort is real; the edge is roughly neutral.

insights.title: For the group chat
insights.finding: A longest killing spree of 21 in real 5v5s (plus 3 more in ARAM and brawls — the group chat can rule on whether those count). Xeebs has receipts.
